name: spiral-horn
why: A conical helix with a taper, the spiral horn: radius 12 to 1.5 over three turns of pitch 10, a 4 mm section tapered to 0.1. Radius and scale are both linear in turn angle on a helix, so V = 4 pi * integral of g(t)^2 sqrt(k^2 + (12 + k t)^2 + c^2) dt = 811.620 mm3 by quadrature of that closed-form integrand; the exact B-rep reads 811.6192 through BRepGProp. Scale linear in arc length instead would be 614.81 — the tripwire for the law's parameterisation changing. The untapered section would cross the axis at the narrow end; the graph checks both ends, so this builds.
